sources.releaseNotes: package/CHANGELOG.md in the verified npm distribution

approval.compatibility: Exact B.1 release and integrity retained after compatibility/security review; self-hosted assets and scoped official CSS through shared React adapters. Auth and Audit use the same foundation. Final accessibility, responsive and CI evidence is recorded in the closure report. Runtime remains disabled.

assets.status: central tokens/font plus scoped component adapters; global component CSS and font policy changes remain deferred

components.status: official component subset through central React adapters only; no global reset or full stylesheet

runtime.reason: Official bootstrap injects inline scripts without nonce support; script-src self remains unchanged. React retains behavior ownership.

migration.target: One official UX4G foundation through the shared CCure Design System for Common, authentication, Audit, Policy, Rank, IR and future modules.
